items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'the occasional melancholy Dane, who’s Palle Mikkelborg on trumpet' as a member of the International Living Time Orchestra, but George Russell does not respond or provide any personal interaction details.

ctx.x: And the States. It’s half and half. It’s American, half British, with the occasional melancholy Dane, who’s Palle Mikkelborg on trumpet.
